invariants.description: Invalid/ambiguous intake cannot mint execution authority
IR is proposed data; runtime remains authority
Parent/child identity and lifecycle transitions are fenced
Progress cannot be inferred from telemetry alone
No provider call after failed budget admission; reserves remain protected
Adaptation cannot override finalization, budget, or evidence boundaries
Elimination is recorded and cannot masquerade as success
Retry is safe only for idempotent/compensated effects
Result cannot imply verification; evidence dereference is explicit
Done requires declared evidence policy
Producer, commit, schema, trust domain, validation state, time, and content digest are bound
stale generation/attempt cannot finish
Capability mismatch degrades only to explicitly supported features
Worker cannot exceed granted lane
Cancel before release; no post-cancel Done
Expired lease reaps and releases capacity
Unknown capacity is conservative and finite
Queue drain re-enters ledger/admission
Verification failure cannot become Done
Finalization is bounded after work failure/cancel and can reopen only for an explicit critical gap
Unknown schema rejected
Projection obeys budget and provenance
Derived indexes never become source truth
Envelope schema/correlation validated
Cache hit cannot cross incompatible trust namespace
Index loss does not change source records
Telemetry loss cannot change authority
Retries are bounded by budget/deadline/backoff
Duplicate/stale/forged lease always rejected
Illegal transitions fail and recovery is deterministic
old/additive/unknown/truncated/corrupt inputs are explicit
Partial final record is ignored; valid prefix survives
No zero-copy claim beyond measured scope
Local API capability is not provider authority
Cache is a candidate, never evidence or Done
Malformed, non-finite, autocorrelated or drifting data cannot produce PASS; raw observations remain hash-bound
Missing runtime capability stays UNKNOWN and cannot become measured electrical or cross-platform evidence
Under-specified workload is UNKNOWN and no universal scaling factor is applied
SIMULATED output cannot be relabelled as observed physical evidence
Missing features, out-of-domain targets or insufficient in-domain anchors cannot yield a validated prediction
Planner never invokes a runner; unavailable, malformed or over-budget mandatory evidence blocks conservatively
Coverage dimensions remain explicit and no aggregate percentage is inferred
Unknown or unmapped dependency widens to retained legacy evidence; SHADOW cannot skip, promote or delete
Missing scope or unknown mapping defaults to RETAIN and never authorizes deletion
Unresolved references remain NOT_MAPPED and invalidate conservatively; graph cannot select or suppress evidence
Each record binds claim, protocol, observation/proof, source SHA, environment, and validator; append-only ledger remains SHADOW and simulation cannot become observation

limitations: GT96 rows are source-backed requirement records; they are not proof that the referenced tests or benchmarks ran.
Symbol-only test and benchmark references remain NOT_MAPPED until resolved to concrete tracked files or runner jobs.
Unmapped surfaces and dependencies require conservative invalidation in the future affected-closure phase.
The graph cannot select, skip, promote or delete evidence while AESE_MODE is SHADOW.
